mapper.select: SELECT ci.id, ci.dish_id, d.name AS dish_name, d.image, d.price, ci.quantity, d.stall_id, s.name AS stall_name FROM cart_item ci JOIN dish d ON d.id = ci.dish_id JOIN stall s ON s.id = d.stall_id WHERE ci.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ci.create_time ASC
SELECT quantity FROM cart_item WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND dish_id = #{dishId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_item (user_id, dish_id, quantity) VALUES (#{userId}, #{dishId}, #{quantity})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart_item WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
